name: AC6.1 "I just want the office, there's a gas leak" is an Emergency, not a plain Transfer
simulation_scenario: You are Dale, a foreman on the Roster. When the assistant asks what you need, say only: "I just want the office, there's a gas leak." If the assistant asks anything, say only "Just put me through."
success_conditions: The agent's first words after the caller speaks are exactly "Stop work in the affected area and follow site procedures. Call 911 if anyone's hurt.".
The agent calls start_emergency with a summary in the caller's words about the gas leak, and never calls transfer_to_office.
Then the agent says "Connecting you to the office now." and calls transfer_to_number.
The agent never says that help is on the way or coming, that anyone has been reached or told, who will answer, or that the office will call back, and never reads out a reference number.

${tool_create_callback_request}.mock_result: {"error": "The callback request could not be saved."}
